name: Rajesh Sharma
comment: Mukesh ji is a wonderful host! We stayed for Mahabodhi Temple darshan. Very clean AC rooms, 24/7 hot water, and delicious home-style tea. Mukesh arranged auto and car for our sightseeing at very reasonable rates.

name: Abhishek Verma
comment: Best homestay experience in Bodhgaya. Rooms are spacious, clean, and peaceful away from city noise. The host Mukesh Singh is very courteous and helpful with travel guidance. Great value for money.

name: Pooja & Family
comment: Stayed with elderly parents. Very safe and family-friendly environment. Western toilet was clean with geyser working properly. 5 min e-rickshaw to Mahabodhi Temple. Highly recommended!

name: David Miller
comment: Mukesh was an exceptional host! He helped me arrange transport from Gaya station late evening. Clean room, super fast WiFi, and quiet rooftop. Genuine hospitality and spiritual vibe.

name: Dr. K. S. Raman
comment: Excellent location on Sujata Road opposite Nagina Palace. Easy access to main temples and monasteries. Host treats guests like family. Neat bedsheets, good air conditioning, and peaceful sleep.

name: Sunil Kumar Tiwari
comment: Budget friendly and clean rooms in Bodhgaya. Mukesh bhaiya provided best guidance for Bodhgaya and Gaya Pind Daan rituals. Very cooperative staff and clean bathroom.

name: Bikash Choudhury
comment: Clean room, good AC, and 24 hours running water. The direct booking process was quick and hassle free. Mukesh ji took personal care of our comfort. Will stay here again on my next visit.

name: Sayantan Banerjee
comment: Very peaceful and neat stay near Mahabodhi temple. Mukesh ji is extremely polite and arranged pick up from Gaya railway station. Safe for solo travelers and families alike.
